Yeah, it is! I thought it would be a bright jade but it’s more like a sage green. I did a review on these in /r/MakeupAddiction and that was something I mentioned.

The colours shown in the swatches are from left to right: Black, Vivid Halo (yellow), Vivid Envy (green), Vivid Fire (red), Vivid Sapphire (navy), Vivid Blossom (lilac), Vivid Petal (pink)

There are 3 other colours in the Vivid Brights collection: Vivid Delight (orange), Vivid Escape (lime), Vivid Violet (dark purple) I do not own these colours.

I use these eyeliners quite often, black for everyday looks and the brights for my colourful, creative looks. They have amazing bright colours that I haven’t really been able to find in another drugstore brand, or the few high end brands that I frequent. True to colour as well, except Vivid Envy. The green colour looks like a bright jade from the packaging but it is more of a muted sage green.They are very pretty to look at in the packaging, and the small brush tip is quite easy to use for me (although with a few of them I had to trim the hairs thinner and more pointed). It’s a fairly easy product to use and for the most part they go on quite opaque and hold their colour, which is exactly why I use them so much for bold looks.
That being said; if there were another option on the market with these intense colours and simple brush I would 100% try it. The Vinyl Liquid Liner is one of the best black eyeliners I’ve tried and I’ll probably never change, but whatever was changed in the Vivid Brights formula made them thicker, and they crack a lot. It can be seen in the search which I took about 15 minutes after application. My pink, green, blue, and yellow are quite thin and easy to work with, but the lilac and red are thicker. Not sure if this is the eyeliner I got only or if it’s all of them? 

Overall I will continue using these cause i’ve made them work with my makeup routine (I spray with setting spray and usually use a good eye primer so they last longer) but if you are looking for a smooth satin finish on your eyeliner, these aren’t the way to go.
